Klasse MACUtils

java.lang.Object
de.bundeswehr.uniity.sedapexpress.utils.MACUtils
public class MACUtils extends Object
Generates and verifies HMAC-SHA-256, AES-CMAC and AES-GMAC values for SEDAP-Express messages. MAC calculation leaves the MAC field empty and does not modify the message while verifying it. Supported wire tag sizes are 32, 128 and 256 bits, subject to the algorithm-specific variants.
Autor:
Volker Voß

      private static byte[] getMessageContentWithoutMAC(SEDAPExpressMessage message)
      Returns the original wire representation, when available, with only the MAC value replaced by an empty field. Locally created messages use their serializer. The message object itself is never modified.

      message - SEDAP-Express message
      Gibt zurück:
      ISO-8859-1 bytes of the message with an empty MAC field

    • isMessageAuthenticWith128BitHMAC

      public static boolean isMessageAuthenticWith128BitHMAC(byte[] key, SEDAPExpressMessage message)
      Verifies a 128-bit HMAC-SHA-256 tag, as required for KEYEXCHANGE phase-2 key confirmation. Unlike isMessageAuthentic(byte[], SEDAPExpressMessage), this method does not accept CMAC/GMAC tags.
      Parameter:
      key - shared HMAC key
      message - parsed message containing the 32-hex-character tag
      Gibt zurück:
      true only when the exact 128-bit HMAC-SHA-256 tag matches
